newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent Group firms on refinery outage.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent Group firms on refinery outage.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline and diesel differentials firmed on Friday on reports of an outage at a Group Three refinery that pumped up spot demand, traders said.
Farmland Industries' 28,000 barrel per day catalytic cracker was taken down for a week to 10 days for unscheduled maintenance, and Farmland was spotted in the market for prompt barrels, traders said.
Traders have said some majors also have been buying of late to cover planned outages later this spring.
Group Three unleaded was heard done at 0.90 cent a gallon under NYMEX March unleaded, with premium talked 3.0 cents a gallon higher.
Chicago unleaded was steady at bids 1.75 cents a gallon under the print, with premium 2.25 cents higher.
High sulphur was bid 3.50 cents a gallon under NYMEX March heating oil in Group Three and 1.0 cent a gallon under the print in Chicago.
